h2. AI-Assisted Triage and Investigate

*Ticket:* WT-16620 | *Age:* 96 days | *Type:* Flaky/Intermittent | *Subsystem:* Test framework (wttimestamp.py) | *Score:* 8/100 — Minimal

h3. Priority Assessment
* Single macos-14-arm64 occurrence after 5+ hours of sequential test execution; 0 BFGs in the last 30 days.
* Not a WiredTiger engine bug — EINVAL is correct engine behaviour; root cause is in the test framework.
* Not blocking any release or trunk; parent WT-16553 already has an auto-resolution rule covering this exact signature.

*Recommended priority:* P4 — close as duplicate of WT-16553.

h3. Root Cause
*TL;DR:* After 13400+ tests run with hook_timestamp.py, auto-incrementing commit timestamps fall below a stable_timestamp advanced by a prior test, causing cursor.insert() to correctly reject with EINVAL.

* *What:* {{test_cursor_random_deleted_all(table.not-sample)}} — {{WiredTigerError: Invalid argument}} at {{cursor.insert()}} in {{ds.populate()}}
* *Where:* {{test/suite/wttimestamp.py:90}} — {{TimestampedCursor.insert()}} sets an auto-incrementing commit timestamp on every insert
* *Why:* The hook_timestamp.py framework wraps every insert with a monotonically increasing commit timestamp starting at 1. After 5+ hours and 13400+ tests, some earlier test advances stable_timestamp to a value ahead of the counter. WiredTiger correctly returns EINVAL for any commit timestamp < stable_timestamp. This is a test framework timestamp lifecycle issue, not a WiredTiger engine bug.

*Confidence:* High — timing is consistent across WT-16553 (13439 tests) and WT-16620 (13400 tests), stack traces are identical, and the error maps directly to the timestamp ordering invariant.

h3. Reproduction
Not attempted — requires 5+ hours of sequential macOS test execution; failure is probabilistic and not triggerable with a targeted command.

h3. Next Action
* Close WT-16620 as Duplicate of WT-16553 (which has an auto-resolution rule for this exact signature: {{test_cursor_random, WiredTigerError: Invalid argument, self._cursor.insert()}}).
* No fix needed on this ticket.
